title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ORGANIZING A PORTION OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF TUBOD, PROVINCE OF LANAO, INTO A MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF BAROY, AND ANNEXING TO THESE MUNICIPALITIES CERTAIN PORTIONS OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF KOLAMBUGAN.

text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
On the northwest, by the limits of the municipal waters of Baroy
from the mouth of the Ininguian Creek to the mouth of the Rawaan
On the southwest, by the northern and eastern boundaries of the
municipality of Lala as defined in Executive Order No. 218, dated
On the south and southeast, by the portion of the Kolambugan-
Kapatagan boundary line fixed in paragraphs 12 and 13 of Executive
Order No. 13, dated April 21, 1917, of the Governor of the Depart
ment of Mindanao and Sulu, outside of the territory of the munice
ipality of Lala.
The seat of government of the municipality of Baroy
shall be at the barrio of Baroy.
The municipality of Tubod shall consist of its present
territory, minus the portion thereof included in the munic-
ipality of Baroy, plus that portion of the territory c:
Kolambugan, bounded in the northeast by a straight line
drawn from the summit of Mount Catmon in southeasterly
direction to its intersection with the Kolambug9-Munal
boundary, and on the south by the southeast portion of
the northeastern boundary of Baroy described above.
The municipality of Kolambugan shall consist of its
present territory minus the portions thereof annexed to
the municipalities or Tabod and Baroy.
The municipality of Baroy herein organized shall begin
to exist upon the appointnient ard qualification of the
mayor, vice-mayor, and a majority of the municipal coun
cilors thereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of June, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
2385
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
